messages:
Dara Johnson: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — need clear dates and the shortest possible executive summary for: API surface rollouts, Console parity for Optimize controls, and Dedicated rollback guarantees.
Arjun Kapoor: Short bullets: alpha (internal) in 8 days, partner canary in 3 weeks, public beta 5 weeks after canary, GA ~11-12 weeks if stable.
Sofia Martinez: +1 on bullet format — partners will see core Optimize Console controls during partner canary. Advanced tuning (per-model quantization suggestions, model-specific presets) locked behind flags until we validate.
Maya Chen: Whats the canary scope? region(s) / % traffic / invited customers?
Arjun Kapoor: Canary = us-west2 only, invited partners + internal traffic (~4% of total). If green at 72h, expand to us-east1 and eu-west1.
Ibrahim Khan: Rollback mechanics: automated traffic steer to previous runtime + model variant, KV cache invalidation for affected nodes, and an immediate runtime flag to disable batching per-model.
Dara Johnson: Can we avoid touching Dedicated pools during rollback? That was a concern in the partner sync.
Sofia Martinez: Yes — Dedicated pools are not changed unless the customer opted into the new runtime. For opted-in tenants we have a two-step rollback that leaves other Dedicated customers untouched.
ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: 1923460005 - 1923460240. Oncall rota created.
Maya Chen: Docs/SDK timeline? Need to align partner comms + release notes.
Arjun Kapoor: Docs refresh + non-breaking SDK patch will ship on day 0 of public beta. Migration guide + sample code + p60/p95 numbers included.
Ibrahim Khan: Monitoring: we'll publish a lightweight dashboard (p50/p95/p99, batch size, KV hit-rate, GPU util). Alerts: p95 latency delta > 20% or KV hit-rate drop > 15% triggers ops channel.
Dara Johnson: Can someone drop a 1-slide exec summary and a 2-page partner checklist? I can edit and send to partners.
Sofia Martinez: I'll draft the checklist (load tests, smoke SDK checks, flag names). Arjun will do the exec slide.
Maya Chen: Office hours? I want a migration walkthrough for partner PMs + support.
Arjun Kapoor: Office hours: next Tue 11:00 PT. Invite + calendar will be posted today.
Dara Johnson: Thanks all. Posting action items to the release plan doc and pinging partners. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
